title: SmolLM training report
finding_and_limit: 135M and 360M models trained on 600B tokens; data curation is central. Published budgets are reference points, not minimum requirements for this task.

title: SmolLM2-135M-Instruct model card
finding_and_limit: 135M, 2T pretraining tokens, Apache-2.0. Function-calling claim applies to 1.7B, not this size. No evidence it reaches our 60/100 conversation gate.

title: Smol-SmolTalk dataset card
finding_and_limit: Shorter conversations for models below 1B; deliberately excludes function calling and advanced math. Useful chat source, not a complete tool curriculum.

title: MobileLLM-125M model card
finding_and_limit: 125M and 1T training tokens; deep/thin design, shared embeddings and GQA. Research license and integration differences make this a design reference, not the first deployment choice.

title: TinyStories
finding_and_limit: Small models can learn coherent constrained-domain stories. This does not establish general conversation or tool competence.

title: Compute-optimal training / Chinchilla
finding_and_limit: Model size and training data must be considered together. Compute-optimal language loss does not imply a guaranteed chat threshold.

title: LIMA
finding_and_limit: The 1,000-example alignment result starts with an already pretrained 65B model. It is not evidence that a weak 97.5M foundation can learn general language from 1,000 examples.

title: APIGen
finding_and_limit: Separates format checking, actual execution and semantic verification. Its published performance does not transfer automatically to a 100M model.

title: APIGen-MT
finding_and_limit: Uses verified task blueprints and complete multi-turn trajectories. Adopt the data-verification principle, not its larger-model benchmark numbers.

title: MiniLLM
finding_and_limit: Distillation uses an on-policy objective and teacher distribution access. Text-only Codex-generated corrections are sequence supervision, not this white-box distillation method.

title: Neural text degeneration
finding_and_limit: Decoding can cause repetitive text; sampling changes generation behavior without establishing factual correctness.

title: Unlikelihood training
finding_and_limit: A training objective can suppress undesirable repetition. It is a secondary option after competence, not a substitute for grounding.

title: XGrammar quick start
finding_and_limit: Grammar constraints can enforce JSON/schema structure. Correct syntax does not choose the right operation, arguments, permission or answer; local integration remains to be tested.

title: FineWeb-Edu
finding_and_limit: Educational filtering offers a candidate source for foundation data. It is not individually verified truth or a substitute for source audits and deduplication.

title: MLX LM
finding_and_limit: Apple-silicon inference and fine-tuning support. Verify the chosen architecture, native template and numerical parity before adopting it.

title: nanowhale-100m model card
finding_and_limit: Author reports ~110M total parameters, 2.6B pretraining tokens and 72.7M SFT tokens over 460K conversations. Held-out token accuracy is not conversation accuracy. Custom architecture increases integration risk.

title: nanochat reference implementation
finding_and_limit: Inspectable end-to-end training and chat pipeline. Its accelerator cost/speed claims are not laptop ETAs or proof of performance under our parameter cap.

title: FunctionGemma
finding_and_limit: Specialized 270M tool model. It exceeds the current 200M cap and is only a possible future option if that cap changes.
